purpose: dose-response of the kick test: the same frozen arms (classical, cls_es s1-2, v11 SNN s1-5, v9 SNN s1-5, v11 imitation start) on two more kick levels, so that crash rate and paired delta can be plotted against hit magnitude (2 / 3 / 4.5 mN m)
unchanged: hit timing t0 + U(0.15, 0.45) s, random horizontal axis, stress condition, bench10 scoring, 64 cases per task, fresh never-used bases
analysis: descriptive: crash rate with exact 95 % intervals and paired delta with bootstrap CI per arm and level; H1 reported per level with the same rule as kick (>= 3 of 5 v11 seeds) but the preregistered primary H1 remains the 3 mN m level
expectation: stated before running: at 2 mN m fewer crashes everywhere and a smaller SNN advantage; at 4.5 mN m the classical crashes in about half of the cases (calibration 9/24) and the SNN advantage may shrink if its own tilt margin is exhausted
